subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's leader-check plus explicit `detached: true` caller-audit as the compatibility-safe Unix process cleanup direction after conflicts are resolved?
rationale: The patch is a plausible and well-proven bug fix, but it changes shared process termination semantics where the wrong default can either terminate the gateway or leave descendant processes alive.

options.title: Resolve conflicts and accept
options.body: Rebase or resolve the branch against current main, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101505's harness fixes, then require exact-head CI/proof before merge.

options.title: Request a narrower variant
options.body: Ask for a smaller helper-only or more exact per-call detached-state approach if unconditional `detached: true` at newer call sites is not the desired contract.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: Close or pause this PR only if maintainers prefer a replacement PR that redoes the same fix on a clean current-main base.

recommendation.title: Resolve conflicts and accept
recommendation.body: Rebase or resolve the branch against current main, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101505's harness fixes, then require exact-head CI/proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the earlier detached-option fix that set the current compatibility baseline.
